environment.services: actual isolated PostgreSQL/MinIO/ClamAV and two independent loopback HTTP simulator clients
environment.identity: static server identity resolver; real SQL memberships/processor/source/PO grants, not production SSO
environment.caseIntegration: actual transactional PENDING case-intent outbox; owning #53 Case processor absent

checks.name: actual exact-engine/fresh-definition complete ClamAV stream readiness
independent order-system HTTP simulator durably stores native raw bytes before 202
same command and reencoded canonical event retain original acknowledgement and every raw receipt
order witness is actually scanned and authorized lineage freezes native/master hashes
independent receiving/counter HTTP simulator creates a durable observation without inventory writes
short cumulative count produces an authorized shared CaseRequest and EventEnvelope, only PENDING intent
different payload under the same source event ID preserves both originals and proposes SOURCE_CONFLICT
new cumulative count is not added twice; prior inventory/PO facts remain unchanged
wrong source principal, source family, client tenant and malformed source payload cannot bypass admission
a valid foreign tenant source can enqueue its own event, but cannot read our source/operations/witness/lineage
actual case-intent/lineage SQL rollback after an injected finalization error, recreated worker retries without duplicates
native receipts, original payload metadata and anchors cannot be overwritten/deleted

limitations: Explicitly simulated external order and cumulative receiving counter; no production ERP/PLC/digital twin
No PO/GRN/payment mutations or autonomous approvals
No completed Case/Decision/Export or production #43 integration is asserted
No process-kill/restore or production latency claim
